name: King Groot (Deathless)

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.

signatureAbility:
Unyielding Might
Gain up to +[40 - 101]% Incinerate duration based on how long the fight has gone on. Max bonus after 100 seconds.
When Malice enters cooldown, gain a Regeneration Buff recovering [6,923 - 17,352.94] Health over 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Unique physiology grants Immunity to Bleed, Power Drain and Power Burn effects.

abilitySections.title: Personal Fury Buffs
content: Unless otherwise stated, personal Fury Buffs each provide +[2,170.5] Attack Rating and last 14 seconds.
When inflicted with a Debuff, spend 1 personal Fury Buff to remove the effect after 0.5 seconds.
When a personal Fury Buff is spent, gain an indefinite Ignition Buff. Max stacks: 3.

abilitySections.title: Malice - Passive
content: Start the fight with a Malice Passive, which grants 3 Fury Buffs each time it activates. Malice lasts as long as at least 1 personal Fury Buff is active.
While Malice is active: Gain up to +100% Fury Buff Potency based on how long the fight has gone on. Max Bonus after 100 seconds.
When Malice ends, it goes on cooldown for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: While Malice is on Cooldown
content: Any attack that makes contact from either Champion has a 30% chance to grant 1 Fury Charge. When cooldown ends, gain 1 Fury Buff for each Charge and re-enter Malice.
When the Opponent Evades, Auto-Blocks, or causes an attack to Miss, gain 2 Fury Charges. Cooldown: 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Deal a burst of [723.5] Energy Damage, this damage is doubled while the Opponent is Incinerated.
Pause all Incinerate and Armor Break Debuffs on the Opponent for 3 seconds.
Malice: Spend 1 Fury Buff to instead Pause for 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit inflicts a [375] Armor Break Debuff for 15 seconds. These Armor Breaks also reduce Energy Resistance by 8%. Max stacks: 10.
Malice: Spend 1 Fury Buff to make the Armor Break indefinite.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each Infernal Breath hit deals a burst of [7,235] Energy Damage. This damage is doubled against #Hero Champions of the Tech Class.
The final hit inflicts an Incinerate Debuff dealing [14,470] Energy Damage over 10 seconds. Max stacks: 2.
When this Incinerate triggers, consume all Ignition Buffs to increase its potency by +30% for each Buff consumed.
Malice: Spend 1 Fury Buff to double the Incinerate's duration.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a Regeneration Buff, recovering [17,307.5] Health over 3 seconds. This Regeneration Buff is paused while Heal Blocked.
Malice: Spend 1 Fury Buff to increase the Regeneration Buff's duration by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Unyielding Might
content: Gain up to +[40 - 101]% Incinerate duration based on how long the fight has gone on. Max bonus after 100 seconds.
When Malice enters cooldown, gain a Regeneration Buff recovering [6,923 - 17,352.94] Health over 12 seconds.
